scenes.text: Use equally spaced axes and plot coordinate pairs (time, measurement), then connect in order.
A line graph begins at 12 on day 1 and increases by 6 daily. Find day 5. The answer is 36. Value on day 5 is 12 plus (5 minus 1) times 6 equals 36.
The reading chart during a sports day shows 12 books on day 1 and rises by 5 each day. What y-value is plotted for day 2? Pause to choose and explain.
The reading chart during a sports day shows 12 books on day 1 and rises by 5 each day. What y-value is plotted for day 2? The answer is 17. Value on day 2 is 12 plus (2 minus 1) times 5 equals 17.
